name: Stream Bot
description: Simple macro player: clicks along a GDR2 macro and starts from your current position, so start pos and practice runs work.

bot-enabled.name: Bot enabled
bot-enabled.description: F9 toggles it in game as well

macro-file.name: Macro file
macro-file.description: Leave empty to auto-pick the macro of the level you play

start-offset.name: Start offset (seconds)
start-offset.description: Macro time at the start of the attempt. -1 = automatic, based on your position

die-before-percent.name: Fake deaths before %
die-before-percent.description: Bot dies randomly before this percent and never after it. 0 = off. Deaths are biased to the start, like a real person learning the level
